what: كل برومبت صورة أو فيديو يحمل سبع طبقات فيزيائية ملموسة بترتيب ثابت. / Every image/video prompt carries seven concrete physical layers in a fixed order.
when: قبل أي برومبت توليد / before any generation prompt
how: Layers: Location · Subject · Wardrobe/materials · Lighting (source + direction + Kelvin) · Camera (body, lens, f-stop, size, move) · Atmosphere (physics: haze, dust, steam) · Technical (aspect, fps, resolution). One-line order: `[STYLE], [COMPOSITION RULE], [CAMERA+LENS+f-stop], [LIGHTING+Kelvin+direction], [SUBJECT texture], [WARDROBE fabric], [ENVIRONMENT layers], [ATMOSPHERE physics], mood: [EMOTION] --ar X:Y`. Example light: soft window key camera-left 3800K, fill −2 stops, cool rim behind; camera: Alexa Mini LF 50 mm f/1.4, eye level, MCU, slow push-in. Kelvin anchors: 1900K lantern, 3200K tungsten, 4100K moonlight, 6500K day.

section: تشريح البرومبت وقواعده — Prompt anatomy & rules
name_en: Iron rules: physical cues beat hype words
what: مصنع البرومبت يحذّرك آليًا من كلمات المبالغة ويطالب بإضاءة بمصدر واتجاه وكلفن. / The forge automatically warns on hype words and demands light with source, direction and Kelvin.
when: عند مراجعة أي برومبت قبل إرساله / when reviewing any prompt before sending
how: Never open with 'a photo of'. Delete 4K/8K/masterpiece/ultra-detailed/award-winning/trending/best quality/beautiful/hyperrealistic — they add noise, not quality. Replace with physical cues: volumetric light, subsurface scattering, chiaroscuro, Rembrandt triangle, anamorphic flare, film grain, atmospheric perspective, tungsten practicals. Coherent style tokens (soft watercolor, line-art, isometric 3D, flat 2D, vintage scientific illustration) keep a set together. Locks must be reused verbatim — a paraphrase is flagged. Ran here: `prompt_forge.py` returned `missing ['lens','style']: prompts will be weaker` for a spec without them.

what: متى تكتب برومبت سلبي طويل (SD/SDXL/Kling) ومتى تحوّل كل نفي إلى حالة إيجابية (Gemini/Flux/Runway). / When to write a long negative (SD/SDXL/Kling) and when to rewrite every exclusion as a positive state (Gemini/Flux/Runway).

Runway inverts or ignores negatives — the forge strips them. Flux has no negative field; Wan keeps negatives short.
params: Flux negative ≈ no effect; SDXL long negatives OK; Runway: none

what: كيف يريد كل مولد برومبته، وكيف تنقل برومبت ميدجورني إلى نموذج بلا أعلام. / How each generator wants its prompt, and how to port a Midjourney prompt to a flag-less model.

Midjourney V7: params at end `--ar 16:9 --style raw --s 150 --v 7 --no text,watermark`; character ref `--oref URL --ow 100` (`--cref/--cw` are V6 only), `--sref URL`, `--stylize 50–250`, `--seed N` for a series; no official API → hand the user the prompt and import the chosen still back. Translation: `--ar`→aspect parameter; drop `--v/--style raw`; `--chaos 50`→'unexpected, surreal composition'; `(word:1.5)`→'prominently featuring word'; delete '8K, masterpiece'; keep camera names.

what: لقطة = أقفال + فعل واحد عبر الزمن + حركة كاميرا واحدة وسرعتها + عدسة + إضاءة + حركة البيئة + مدة/fps + أسلوب + نسبة. / Shot = locks + one action over time + one camera move & speed + lens + light + environment motion + duration/fps + style + aspect.
when: أي برومبت نص→فيديو أو صورة→فيديو
how: 50–100 words (Runway best <100). Always state the camera move or 'static' — it is the parameter that changes results most and is most often forgotten. One scene per clip, never a scene change inside a clip, never request on-screen text. Generate 3–4 variations, then iterate on the best. Most-used camera words: wide, close-up, low angle, tracking, handheld, slow motion, establishing, crane, pan, dutch, bird's-eye, dolly zoom, rack focus; 2.35:1 reads as cinema.
params: 50–100 words; 1 camera move; 3–4 variations; shot 5–10 s

what: كل توليد مدفوع مُسعَّر ومسقوف ومُجرَّب جافًا ومرسل مرة واحدة ومُوصَّل عند القبول وقابل للاستئناف فلا يُدفع مرتين. / Every paid generation is priced, capped, dry-run, sent once, receipted at acceptance and resumable, so nothing is paid twice.

Riskiest shot first as a pilot. 2 variations in round 1; change one axis per round (subject, composition, light, style or palette); yield <30 % = weak prompt; >3 rounds on one asset = switch to composition. what: لا وجوه أو أصوات أشخاص حقيقيين، لا «بأسلوب» فنان حي، لا شعارات أو شخصيات محمية، لا مشاهد وثائقية مزيفة؛ وسم المولّد وتوثيق مصدره. / No real people's faces or voices, no living artist's style, no logos or copyrighted characters, no fake documentary scenes; label and track generated media.

It is a text plan review only — it does not render, speed up ffmpeg or unlock tools. Normal work never needs it: Claude Code itself is the director. Not run here (no key, no paid call).

name_en: Higgsfield reference-video production parameters and prompt skeleton
what: معاملات إنتاج مجرّبة لتوليد لقطات فيديو من صور مرجعية عبر Higgsfield، وهيكل برومبت يصف الأداء لا الشكل فقط. — Tested production settings for generating video shots from reference images on Higgsfield, and a prompt skeleton that directs the performance, not just the look.
when: المستخدم يريد لقطات مولدة وصرّح بالإنفاق — the user wants generated shots and has authorised spend.
how: Stills at 2k–4k for references; video at 1080p, high bitrate, generate_audio off, 4–30 s, delivered as 24 fps HEVC; in the owner's films ≈ 12 credits per second at 1080p, ≤ 12 jobs per batch, 3–6 min per 5 s clip, plus a ~30 % reshoot reserve. Skeleton: REFERENCE DEFINITIONS / SCENE / CHARACTERS / WORLD / ACTING TASK (motive, goal, obstacle, tactic) / SHOTS with timecodes / CAMERA AND LOOK / AUDIO / CONSTRAINTS; one continuous shot with one motivated move; open mid-motion with the money moment 1–3 s in. Model names and prices drift: list the connector's current models and quote cost before generating; never spend without explicit approval.
